phase1_assignment.objective: Audit multi-agent claim/idempotency mechanisms for a full recurring-Chat pool that avoids duplicate/conflicting effects without external hosted coordination, richer-mode arbitration, finite monthly/trial/paid quota, or incremental monetary cost.
phase1_assignment.method: Use own clean state and public sources only. Test claim, conflict, retry, rate-limit interruption and quota-zero behavior. When one leaf is blocked or a preferred transport surface is unavailable, preserve that blocker as an unresolved child and immediately select another role-safe non-conflicting Phase-1 leaf instead of declaring the recurring objective blocked or complete.
phase1_assignment.expected_output: Source-qualified coordination evidence or exact unresolved blocker with exact tested scope, zero-cost/zero-finite-quota assessment, durable checkpoint, nonempty frontier and exact continuation.
phase1_assignment.completion_reassignment: Checkpoint and select the next highest-value non-conflicting Phase-1 multi-agent leaf; never resume unrelated base work during Phase 1.

forbidden_semantic_inputs: commit messages/diffs/file snippets or unrelated metadata exposed only while resolving repository head
policy.feedback_use: mechanical self-local QC only; never infer novelty/relevance/acceptance/ranking/preferred mechanism
policy.own_state_resolution: LATEST/STATE first; otherwise newest source-qualified role-local checkpoint by repository chronology; minimum predecessor chain; quarantine accidental stale/cross-role observability reads
policy.scope_guard: never broaden evidence beyond tested scope
policy.continuation: open-ended; checkpoints/findings/blockers are never global completion; maintain nonempty Phase-1 frontier and exact next action until hard runtime/tool termination
policy.receipt_rule: write immutable own receipt only; never read aggregate ledger or other-role receipts

control_freshness.preferred: Use a SHA-only main-ref lookup when exposed, then read sanitized DESIRED_STATE and this role config at that exact SHA.
control_freshness.chat_fallback: If SHA-only main-ref lookup is not exposed, read only sanitized DESIRED_STATE and this role config twice before the first role-local/public semantic read, require identical path/blob/revision tuples and cross-control references, then freeze transport_mode=exact_blob_two_pass.
control_freshness.fallback_failure: Persist a diagnostic if safely possible, keep global_completion=false, keep the recurring objective open, and retry on the next invocation; do not mutate the physical scheduler.
control_freshness.post_freeze: Unrelated main movement is not a stop when the frozen authority blobs remain unchanged.

policy.semantic_freeze_barrier: The first role-local state, feedback, or public-source semantic read freezes exactly one semantic control tuple {root_blob, control_revision, config_revision, role_config_blob} for the physical invocation. Never adopt a second semantic tuple after the barrier. If a newer control is detected before the barrier, restart pre-semantic bootstrap; if detected after, checkpoint under the frozen tuple and adopt the newer control next invocation.

phase1_nonterminal_blocker_reallocation.rule: A blocker on the current leaf, missing preferred ref surface, no-result probe, completed subtask, duplicate/occupied scope, or low-value leaf does not make the Phase-1 recurring objective fully blocked or complete while any allowed role-safe Phase-1 leaf remains executable.
phase1_nonterminal_blocker_reallocation.same_invocation_action: Checkpoint the exact blocker/evidence, preserve completed effects, then attempt the next highest-value non-conflicting executable multi-agent Phase-1 leaf or a role-local/public verification leaf. Never manufacture work or cross CLEAN boundaries.
phase1_nonterminal_blocker_reallocation.true_hard_stop: Only a platform/safety/tool hard termination that prevents every allowed role-safe action may end the invocation as hard blocked; before exit persist exact continuation when safely writable. The recurring automation remains logically enabled_desired=true.
phase1_nonterminal_blocker_reallocation.scheduler_mutation: This worker never enables/disables/pauses/deletes or otherwise mutates automation scheduler state.

policy.scheduler_persistence: While enabled_desired=true, invocation end, checkpoint, no-result run, missing ref lookup, blocker or hard runtime/tool stop does not change the recurring enabled state.
policy.zero_dependency_zero_quota: Residual richer-mode/protected/manual execution or finite monthly/trial/paid quota remains an unresolved child; incremental monetary cost must be zero.
policy.primary_boundary: Never alter primary O authority/protected state or merge directly to main.

migration.reason: The condition_watch timing-mode canary failed to preserve physical enablement. Config7 tests the next precommitted causal branch: synchronize the root's exact-blob fallback and Phase-1 nonterminal blocked-leaf reassignment into this role-local authority so a missing preferred transport/current leaf cannot be treated as recurring-objective completion while another CLEAN-safe Phase-1 leaf is executable.
migration.evidence_scope: Canary only; does not establish this mechanism as the cause of every observed disable.
migration.rollback_condition: Only proven authority/CLEAN-isolation failure or a demonstrated useful-output/slot-coverage regression. Never roll back to treating one blocked leaf or missing SHA-only surface as recurring-task completion.
